weights_rationale: Source_markets is low_confidence (indirect UK/Germany/France/US inference from English-only site and Montenegro macro data), so country is capped at 8. The campaign offer is current_buyer framing - finding operators who could SEND clients to the DMC - so destination_overlap is positive (18): operators already selling Adriatic/Mediterranean/Balkans are the most realistic referral source. travel_type (18) and icp (18) tie as the dominant signals: luxury and boutique_advisor alignment are non-negotiable filters for a helicopter-and-yacht-charter DMC. niche_penalty (14) is moderate-high to screen out wine/polar/safari-only operators clearly outside the Adriatic luxury segment.
prospect_summary: DMC Discover Montenegro is Montenegro's first luxury destination management company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Tivat (Boka Bay). They offer the full range of luxury inbound services - hotel bookings at top properties (Aman Sveti Stefan, Regent Porto Montenegro, The Chedi Lustica Bay), custom itineraries, helicopter and yacht charters, private jet transfers, concierge, and tailored MICE solutions for corporate and private clients. They have a dedicated B2B travel agents program and are affiliated with Riana Group DMCC. Their positioning is unambiguously upmarket: discreet luxury, seamless service, targeting individuals, groups, and investors seeking premium Montenegro experiences.
